ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light grey) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted with low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming a continuous 5-15% perimeter boundary and a central vertical median band.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity pigmentation forms a thick, irregular border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; a prominent dark vertical column extends from the peduncle to the median notch; a single dark circular focal spot is located in the upper-mid right lobe, and an elongated dark horizontal dash is located in the lower-mid right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; prominent jagged irregularities and macro-peaks are visible on the distal right tip and the segment immediately adjacent to the right side of the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge margins leading to sharp, angular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a single high-contrast dark circular pixel cluster in the upper right quadrant; smaller, lower-contrast mottled clusters are visible near the trailing edge of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, unaligned horizontal dark linear mark is visible on the right lobe; multiple faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible in the central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged indentation on the superior margin of the right distal tip; pronounced dark vertical scar-like pigmentation at the junction of the peduncle and fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity punctate pixel noise across the lower central fluke surface corresponding to water spray/droplets.
